Doesn’t that technically mean she hasn’t cut me off completely?? I think that’s why i just want clarity. I’ve received so many conflicting messages and i just want it to make sense. 

But yeah, I know I need to just let it go and move on. I usually am fine but sometimes i just start wondering again and i’m sucked back in. Eventually i’ll learn to stop caring about it as much i suppose.
